depiction_rules.notes: A divine form of Vishnu, shown respectfully and modestly; maintain one consistent face, complexion, hair, dress and jewelry across D029 stanzas 2–4 and 9–10.

visual_bible.appearance: Youthful adult feminine divine form with gentle dark eyes, composed expression, deep brown hair, restrained ochre jewelry and deep maroon/cream drapery.
visual_bible.clothing: Securely draped, opaque, modest sari-style clothing with no exposed torso; movement never makes clothing reveal the body.
visual_bible.body: One natural two-armed, two-legged body with attached limbs and proportionate hands.
visual_bible.style: Traditional matte mineral-pigment mural with firm dark contours, no sensual gloss or metallic shine.
